rec.text: I think I may have fixed the tutorial stuffs. Match 3D iOS Internal - #1718 already tested

Hey guys, here is the list of issues that will be part of submission today.
• *Individual quest claim issues <@EMPLOYEE_0006_SLACK_ID>* 
    ◦ After claiming Quest and achievement the button is still visible and I can spam them :warning: 
        ▪︎ I also need to stay in quest page after claiming it because of the waiting time. If I left, the quest cannot be claimed. 
        ▪︎ If I change tab after claiming them, the vfx starts for another tab. So if ı claim quest and go to achievements ı will see achievement vfx and vice versa
• Reward animations for boosts doesn't show the correct amount in boosts. It always shows 2 for the boosts regardless of the actual amount.  :warning: <@EMPLOYEE_0006_SLACK_ID> 
• Every reward animation has SFX and cannot be toggled off. <@EMPLOYEE_0006_SLACK_ID> 
• Boss arena event sprite is not centered in tablet resolution. <@EMPLOYEE_0032_SLACK_ID> 
• The effect unlock animations in the levels needs engineering help after Marcus's changes. <@EMPLOYEE_0003_SLACK_ID> 
*In season pass branch,* 
• The events in the left column are not visible at all. :warning: <@EMPLOYEE_0003_SLACK_ID> 
• Opening reward packs shows tap to open screen after it's already opened. :warning: <@EMPLOYEE_0003_SLACK_ID> 
• Premium pass shows 9.99$ but its actual cost is 6.99$ :warning: <@EMPLOYEE_0003_SLACK_ID> 
• Bonus bank screen overlaps with the unclaimed rewards. <@EMPLOYEE_0003_SLACK_ID> 
    ◦ The box has no opening animation. <@EMPLOYEE_0002_SLACK_ID> 
• Infinite boss leaderboard has the correct golden name after premium pass but silver avatar frame, where as endless mode leaderboard has the correct golden avatar frame but not golden name.  <@EMPLOYEE_0003_SLACK_ID> 
*For win&collect, I haven't seen any update or build about it. <@EMPLOYEE_0021_SLACK_ID>* 

Visuals in the thread.
I finished endless horde for the 3rd time, and on the third time my game hard froze at this screen, I think a lot of physics was running in the background and it really needs to be paused

*Julia Lawson*  [9:46 PM]
Hey, guys. We just finished talking with [PERSON_NAME_0029]. And basically:

• Don't use Domino Delights documents for Zombie Match features, please. The system can be the same but There are nuances that create edge cases. For example, with daily login, because we don't have a queue manager yet, he had to do something else with the animations and that was one of the issues in the last week's meetings. 
• Because [PERSON_NAME_0029] tends to do small tasks and they can be popping in and out, he struggles with prioritization. Please take extra care with his tickets and consider his other tickets when you set priority for a new ticket.
• Engineers struggle when documents are incomplete in quantity, a simple reward on our document can mean a bigger task on the client or backend side we can't anticipate as designers, so please make sure your documents are completed in this regard before you kickoff a feature.
• We did remind him we expect documents to be a guide of its own without additional tickets. So let's make sure our documentation is complete at best we can.
The input blocker happens after every level not just if it has tutorial or panel
We talked with [PERSON_NAME_0050], the input blocker is not a problem right now. Probably we need to check that after adding collect&win to queuemanager
After I skipped the zombie lane tutorial, ı got the exception and skipping couldn’t claim the ice cream. <@EMPLOYEE_0003_SLACK_ID>
One thing I noticed is season pass vfx played before it’s unlocked

rec.title: Queue Manager
rec.description:
We need to create a system to orchestrate panels and animations on the Main Menu. This system should be dynamic, similar to DD. When we implement a new Live-Ops, we’ll add its order into this system.

Through this system, we’ll handle the following:

* Tutorials
* Level-end animations
* Trash in/out animations
* Claimed reward animations
* Live-Ops token animations
* The order of opening Live-Ops panels
